jobs.name: bot_avatar_monogram
jobs.prompt: Square avatar for a Telegram bot of «ИИаватар» — an AI video production service (text turns into video with a digital presenter). Design system of the website: deep black background #0E0E0E, white bold geometric grotesque type, one acid lime-yellow accent #D7F23C. Composition strictly centred, everything important inside the central 70% (the image will be cropped to a circle). A bold white monogram «ИИ» (two Cyrillic letters И, perfectly spelled, heavy grotesque, tight spacing) with a small solid lime-yellow play-triangle integrated next to or inside the letters. Flat vector, crisp, minimal, premium, high contrast, readable at 64 px. No other text, no gradients-noise, no mockup frame, no shadows around the canvas.
jobs.meaning: аватарка бота ИИаватар: белая монограмма «ИИ» и лаймовый треугольник «play» на чёрном фоне, по центру

jobs.name: bot_avatar_presenter
jobs.prompt: Square avatar for a Telegram bot of «ИИаватар» — an AI video production service with digital presenters. Deep black background #0E0E0E with one acid lime-yellow accent #D7F23C and white. Strictly centred composition, all inside the central 70% (cropped to a circle). A minimal flat vector icon: a stylised friendly head-and-shoulders silhouette of a digital presenter (simple geometric shapes, no facial details) framed inside a rounded video frame, with a small lime-yellow play-triangle badge at the lower right of the frame. Crisp, modern, premium, high contrast, readable at 64 px. NO text, no letters at all.
jobs.meaning: аватарка бота ИИаватар без текста: силуэт цифрового ведущего в видео-рамке с лаймовым значком play, чёрный фон

jobs.name: bot_avatar_textvideo
jobs.prompt: Square avatar for a Telegram bot that receives client requests for «ИИаватар» — a service that turns text into video. Deep black background #0E0E0E, white, one acid lime-yellow accent #D7F23C. Strictly centred composition, all inside the central 70% (cropped to a circle). A minimal flat vector symbol of the idea «text → video»: a white chat/message bubble with three short horizontal text lines (abstract lines, not letters) that morphs on its right side into a lime-yellow play-triangle. One single cohesive mark. Crisp, modern, premium, high contrast, readable at 64 px. NO text, no letters at all.
jobs.meaning: аватарка бота заявок ИИаватар без текста: белое облачко сообщения, переходящее в лаймовый треугольник play (текст → видео), чёрный фон
